# AAP (Alliance for Affordable Prescriptions)

> > AAP is an independent pharmacy cooperative providing business resources, advocacy, and programs like ProfitAmp and SmartSync to help independent pharmacies compete against PBMs and chain retailers.

The site serves independent pharmacy owners with membership benefits, regulatory updates on PBM reform and FTC policy, operational guides for pharmacy acquisition and medication synchronization, and marketing resources. AAP advocates for healthcare reform affecting community pharmacies while offering practical tools for business optimization.

## Key Topics

- Independent Pharmacy
- PBM Regulation & Reform
- Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs)
- FTC Policy & Advocacy
- AAP Membership & Programs
- ProfitAmp
- SmartSync (MedSync)
- Pharmacy Acquisition & Ownership
- Healthcare Reform
- FDA & CMS Regulations
- Community Pharmacy Services
- Vaccine Administration
- Pharmacy Business Operations
- NCPA Partnership
- Retail Plan-O-Grams

## AAP Membership & Programs

- [AAP Independent Pharmacy Cooperative](https://www.rxaap.com/aap-membership): AAP cooperative membership benefits, pricing, rebates & business resources
- [Actual Value of AAP Programs](https://www.rxaap.com/article-the-actual-value-of-aap-programs): AAP programs overview: ProfitAmp, SmartSync, Scan & Toss value analysis

## PBM Regulation & Healthcare Policy

- [PBM Reform Enacted](https://www.rxaap.com/pbm-reform-enacted): Medicare Part D reforms & FTC-Express Scripts settlement on PBM practices
- [The FTC is reevaluating PBMs and their role in the market](https://www.rxaap.com/ftc-reevaluating-pbms): FTC's unanimous vote to reevaluate PBM market practices and regulations
- [New Push from the White House: Tighter Rules on Prescription Drug Advertising](https://www.rxaap.com/new-push-from-the-white-house-tighter-rules-on-prescription-drug-advertising): White House FDA policy push for stricter prescription drug advertising rules
- [Weekly Rx Roundup for July 17, 2023](https://www.rxaap.com/weekly-rx-roundup-for-july-17-2023): Weekly pharmacy news roundup covering PBM regulation & OTC contraceptive

## Pharmacy Operations & Business Guides

- [What to Know Before Buying a Pharmacy: A Comprehensive Guide](https://www.rxaap.com/guide-to-buying-an-independent-pharmacy): Comprehensive guide on pharmacy acquisition and due diligence essentials

- [Video Marketer Rx: Essential Tools for Successful Videos](https://www.rxaap.com/tips-for-making-marketing-videos): DIY video marketing tips for pharmacy social media on TikTok & Facebook
